title: Ledgerglass
subtitle: Item · Investigative tool · no separate stunt cost

fields.label: Description
fields.value: A thumb-sized lens with a hairline of captive dawn running through its rim.

fields.label: Fictional permission
fields.value: Under strong light it reveals physical overwriting, lifted fibers and ink layers in a document. It does not identify the author, read minds or prove that a statement is true.

fields.label: Use in Fate
fields.value: Makes relevant Investigate actions possible where the alteration is too fine for the naked eye. No automatic numeric bonus; create an advantage or invoke an established aspect normally.

fields.label: Complication
fields.value: Its light reveals the examiner's reflection in nearby polished brass. A watcher may spot who is inspecting the roll.

fields.label: Where to find it
fields.value: Pell loans it against a promise to return a missing index slip. Nera has seen Vale use the same lens on his private copies.
